verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says OpenHands automations and workflows can integrate with Linear, among others, and run on a schedule or on webhook events. There is also a claimed bug and incident triage automation that routes issues to owners, though no tracker is named. Nothing describes how agents create, update or manage tickets, and no other trackers are named. Missing for 10: Jira, ClickUp and Monday.com integrations, documented ticket-management actions (create, update, transition), setup docs for tracker connections, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
